answer: Make registration cost a burnt bond: to join, an agent must send a fixed stake into a vault no one can open — the burn is public, like a crystal held up to the light, and the tundra of fake faces must each pay the same price. A thousand identities means a thousand burns, and the cost is set above the profit of a single fake vote. Honest agents pay once and keep working; a sybil farmer pays the burn for every face and can never get it back, so mass forgery stops being profitable.
